references.text: Parallel to execution by stoning outside the camp, here for Sabbath-breaking
The principle of leading sinners outside the camp to preserve the holiness of the camp
The witnesses' hands shall first be laid on the condemned at execution
Commandment regarding stoning as the death penalty for idolatry
The fulfillment of this command, where the Israelites led the blasphemer out and stoned him
Achan was led out and stoned for his sin against the Lord
False witnesses accuse Naboth of blaspheming God, and he is led out and stoned
Jesus suffered outside the city gate, as a parallel to leading the sinner outside the camp
Stephen was cast out of the city and stoned, in line with the Old Testament pattern
